claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings are NECESSARY AND SUFFICIENT for three complementary non-jurist-preference views at characterized minimal scales: (1) Citation Heritage View — AUC > 0.75 at 21yr+/137k+ (superior to TF-IDF); (2) Section Cross-Lingual View — Sachverhalt cross_lang_same_branch > 0.2, Dispositiv > 0.1 at 1K sample (Erwaegungen FAILS); (3) Linear Hybrid Complement — PASS adversarial gates at 19yr+/122k+ (w=0.3-0.4) but JP remains BELOW TF-IDF baseline (0.78-0.79). Dense embeddings FAIL jurist gate at ALL scales (JP 0.05-0.43). True OOS JP ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target. No representation beats TF-IDF citation hybrids for primary navigation. Multi-view architecture required.
evidence_summary: Recomputed all 3 complementary modes from primary evidence files: (1) Citation heritage: 21yr AUC 0.8455/0.8182 (raw/cp64), 22yr AUC 0.7946/0.7922, 24yr AUC 0.7696/0.7667/0.7669 (cp768/cp64/cp128) with 730 positive pairs — all center_projected > 0.75 threshold, superior to TF-IDF citation baseline ~0.71-0.74. (2) Section cross-lingual: Sachverhalt cp64 cross_lang=0.282 (>0.2) gap=0.187, Dispositiv cp64 cross_lang=0.150 (>0.1) gap=0.397, Erwaegungen cp64 cross_lang=0.094 (<0.1) gap=0.452 — hierarchy Sachverhalt > Dispositiv > Erwaegungen confirmed. (3) Linear hybrids: 22yr weight sweep shows w=0.3-0.4 PASS both adversarial gates (JP 0.6715-0.6725, LangDom 0.606-0.654) but below TF-IDF JP=0.784; cross_lang improvement +29% over TF-IDF. Two-mode tradeoff reproduced at 8 scales. Dense JP fails at all scales (3yr-165k). v18 coarse hierarchy negative (max purity 0.65 < 0.7). Legal TF-IDF bge_ corpus negative (6-8/14 PASS). Three prior audit repairs verified fixed: comprehensive_validation JP anomaly resolved (v5 baseline JP=0.4892), citation_role_integration fractal collapse detected (base roles FAIL_DEGENERATE), overclustering gate implemented (valid_representation required). Data blockers correctly identified: bge_/bger_ mapping, parquet 2024-2026 (15,536 decisions), section extraction at 174k. 2022-2023 embeddings EXIST and PASS quality (AUC > 0.75). All negative results honestly represented.
